## Ellie — Free Business Registration

Receives every tool call from the Retell agent and emails the team.

**Setup (2 minutes):**
1. Connect a Gmail account on the **Email the Team** node.
2. Change `TEAM_INBOX` in the **Format Call Event** node if it should go somewhere other than Saif.
3. Toggle the workflow **Active** (top right). The webhook is only live when active.

Production URL ends `/webhook/fbr` — it must match the `url` in
`agent/clients/free-business-registration/functions.json`.

One handler covers all seven tools, so adding a tool needs no change here.
